name: app-dark-thanks-for-watching-huge-caps-with-follow-pill-and-cursor-tags
title: Huge Thanks Caps with Follow Pill and Live Cursors
whatItIs: A near-black slide with column guides, service labels across the top, giant silver-to-dark caps 'THANKS FOR WATCHING!' crossed by a tilted indigo Follow us pill, a caption in caps and contact lines shown as selected text with collaborator cursors.
whatItMeans: Live cursors and selection boxes make the closing feel like a working Figma file, and the fading caps add depth.
techniques: Giant gradient caps fading to dark
Tilted indigo pill overlapping the type
Contact text shown selected with cursor tags
Thin column guides across the frame

vocabulary.definition: A small labelled pointer imitating a collaborator in a design tool.
A blue outline around text as if selected.
Uppercase type fading in tone across its width.
